Definition: The intensity of heat present in water
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of average kinetic energy of water molecules
SI_Unit: deg F,  K, K (typically reported in deg C)
Measurement_Methods: Direct measurement via thermistor thermocouple or expansion thermometer
Common_Instruments: YSI ProDSS, Hach HQ40d, Onset Tidbit, HOBO Water Temp Pro

Definition: Negative base-10 logarithm of hydrogen ion activity in water
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of acidity alkalinity indicates proton concentration
Common_Instruments: YSI pH probe, Hach pH electrode, Hanna Instruments

Definition: Concentration of oxygen gas dissolved in water
Scientific_Meaning: Amount of O2 available for aquatic respiration and chemical oxidation
Expected_Range: 0 to 20 mg/L (depending on temperature and pressure)
Measurement_Methods: Membrane electrode (Clark cell) optical luminescence Winkler titration
Common_Instruments: YSI ProODO, Hach LDO, WTW Oxibar

Definition: Measure of light scattering by suspended particles in water
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of water clarity and particulate concentration
SI_Unit: FNU,  FTU, m-1 (SI) but typically NTU

Definition: Measure of water ability to conduct electrical current
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of ionic concentration and dissolved solids
Measurement_Methods: Measurement via alternating current and voltage drop
Common_Instruments: YSI ProDSS, Hach HQ40d, WTW Cond 3110

Definition: Volume of water passing a point per unit time
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of hydraulic discharge and water movement

Definition: Vertical distance from water surface to bottom
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of water body volume and habitat availability
Common_Instruments: PTX Pressure Transponder, SonTek CastAway, measuring tape

Definition: Concentration of nitrate (NO3-) in water
Scientific_Meaning: Key nutrient for aquatic plant growth indicator of agricultural runoff
Expected_Range: 0 to 10+ mg/L as N (polluted to pristine)
Measurement_Methods: Ion-selective electrode spectrophotometry (cadmium reduction) ion chromatography
Common_Instruments: YSI NO3 probe, Hach Nitrax sc, Dionex ICS
accepted_units: mg/L as N|mg/L asNO3|mg/l as N|mg/l asNO3|mol/m3

Definition: Concentration of ammonium (NH4+) in water
Scientific_Meaning: Bioavailable nitrogen form product of organic matter decomposition
Expected_Range: 0 to 5+ mg/L as N (typically low in oxic waters)
Common_Instruments: YSI NH4 probe, Hach Amtax sc

Definition: Concentration of phosphate (PO4 3-) in water
Scientific_Meaning: Limiting nutrient in freshwater systems indicator of wastewater agricultural input
accepted_units: mg/L as P|mg/L asPO4|mg/l as P|mg/l asPO4|mol/m3

Definition: Concentration of chlorophyll-a pigment in water
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of phytoplankton biomass and primary production
Common_Instruments: YSI EXO2, Turner Designs Cyclops-7F, bbe FluoroProbe

Definition: Concentration of fecal coliform bacteria in water
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of fecal contamination and potential pathogen presence
Common_Instruments: Membrane filtration multiple tube fermentation (MPN), IDEXX Colilert, Millipore MF-MEndo

Definition: Temperature measured at specific depths in water column
Scientific_Meaning: Vertical temperature profile indicating stratification and mixing
Common_Instruments: YSI EXO2 with temp chain, SeaBird SBE 19plus

Definition: Ratio of measured DO to saturated DO at given temperature and pressure
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of oxygen availability relative to equilibrium
Measurement_Methods: Calculated from DO concentration temperature salinity pressure
Related_Variables: Dissolved Oxygen Concentration Water Temperature Salinity Atmospheric Pressure

Definition: Mass of filterable particles per volume of water
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of particulate matter excluding dissolved substances
Common_Instruments: Gravimetric filtration (GF/C filter 105 deg C), Whatman GF/C filter, analytical balance

Definition: Measure of heat in ambient air above water surface
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of atmospheric conditions affecting water body
Related_Variables: Water Temperature Relative Humidity Wind Speed

Definition: Concentration of chloride ion in water
Scientific_Meaning: Major anion indicating salinity and anthropogenic inputs
Related_Variables: Specific Conductance Sulfate Total Dissolved Solids

Definition: Concentration of sulfate ion in water
Scientific_Meaning: Major anion indicator of mineral weathering and acid mine drainage

Definition: Concentration of dissolved silica (SiO2) in water
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of silicate weathering essential nutrient for diatoms
Accepted_Synonyms: SiO2, Silicate, Dissolved silica, Reactive silica

Definition: Acid-neutralizing capacity of water
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of carbonate bicarbonate buffering capacity
Accepted_Synonyms: Total alkalinity, Carbonate alkalinity, Acid neutralizing capacity
Related_Variables: pH Dissolved Inorganic Carbon Specific Conductance

Definition: Concentration of all dissolved solids in water
Scientific_Meaning: Total concentration of dissolved substances indicator of salinity
Common_Instruments: Gravimetric (evaporation at 180 deg C) calculated from specific conductance, Analytical balance conductivity meter

Definition: Amount of dissolved oxygen consumed by microorganisms during decomposition of organic matter
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of organic pollution and water quality
Accepted_Synonyms: BOD, BOD5, BOD7, Biochemical Oxygen Demand
Measurement_Methods: Respirometric method (5-day incubation at 20 deg C)

Definition: Amount of oxygen required to chemically oxidize organic and inorganic matter
Scientific_Meaning: Indicator of total oxidizable material in water
Accepted_Synonyms: COD, CODCr, CODMn, Chemical Oxygen Demand, Permanganate COD, Dichromate COD

Definition: Sum of nitrate nitrite and ammonium nitrogen in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Key nutrient pool for primary production
Measurement_Methods: Calculated from individual species Ion chromatography
Common_Instruments: Nitrate Nitrogen Ammonium Nitrogen Nitrite Nitrogen

Definition: Sum of all dissolved nitrogen species in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Total dissolved nitrogen pool
Accepted_Synonyms: TDN, Total Dissolved Nitrogen, Filtered Total Nitrogen
Common_Instruments: Nitrate Nitrogen Ammonium Nitrogen Dissolved Organic Nitrogen

Definition: Sum of nitrate nitrite and ammonium nitrogen
Scientific_Meaning: Inorganic nitrogen fraction
Common_Instruments: Nitrate Nitrogen Ammonium Nitrogen Nitrite Nitrogen

Definition: Sum of organic nitrogen and ammonium nitrogen
Scientific_Meaning: Measure of organic plus ammonia nitrogen
Accepted_Synonyms: TKN, Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen, Kjeldahl Nitrogen
Common_Instruments: Total Nitrogen Ammonium Nitrogen Dissolved Organic Nitrogen

Definition: Sum of all nitrogen species in water
Scientific_Meaning: Total nitrogen pool
Common_Instruments: Nitrate Nitrogen Ammonium Nitrogen Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen

Definition: Dissolved organic nitrogen fraction in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Organic nitrogen in dissolved phase

Definition: Total organic nitrogen in water
Scientific_Meaning: Organic nitrogen fraction

Definition: Sum of ammonia (NH3) and ammonium (NH4+) nitrogen
Scientific_Meaning: Total ammonia nitrogen species
Accepted_Synonyms: TAN, Total Ammonia Nitrogen, Ammonia Ammonium

Definition: Dissolved organic nitrogen plus ammonium in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Dissolved Kjeldahl fraction
Common_Instruments: Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen Dissolved Organic Nitrogen

Definition: Concentration of nitrite (NO2-) in water
Scientific_Meaning: Intermediate nitrogen species indicator of nitrification
accepted_units: mg/L as N|mg/L asNO2|mg/l as N|mg/l asNO2|mol/m3

Definition: Concentration of dissolved inorganic phosphorus (orthophosphate) in filtered water

Accepted_Synonyms: DIP, Dissolved Inorganic Phosphorus, Dissolved Orthophosphate

Definition: Sum of all dissolved phosphorus species in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Total dissolved phosphorus pool
Accepted_Synonyms: TDP, Total Dissolved Phosphorus, Filtered Total Phosphorus
Related_Variables: Total Phosphorus Dissolved Inorganic Phosphorus Dissolved Organic Phosphorus

Definition: Sum of dissolved and particulate inorganic phosphorus
Scientific_Meaning: Inorganic phosphorus fraction

Definition: Total organic phosphorus in water
Scientific_Meaning: Organic phosphorus fraction

Definition: Particulate organic phosphorus fraction
Scientific_Meaning: Organic phosphorus in particulate phase

Definition: Particulate phosphorus fraction
Scientific_Meaning: Phosphorus in particulate phase

Definition: Concentration of total carbon in water
Scientific_Meaning: Sum of organic and inorganic carbon
Common_Instruments: Total Organic Carbon Total Inorganic Carbon

Definition: Concentration of dissolved inorganic carbon in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Carbonate system component alkalinity contributor

Definition: Concentration of dissolved organic carbon in filtered water
Scientific_Meaning: Organic carbon in dissolved phase
Common_Instruments: Total Organic Carbon Particulate Organic Carbon

Scientific_Meaning: Inorganic carbon fraction

Scientific_Meaning: Sum of dissolved and particulate organic carbon
